title: Pooling Samples and Distribution to Cepheid
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Load Cepheid adapter on OT‑2 deck
steps.instruction: Place the Cepheid device on the custom adapter and position the adapter on the OT‑2 deck, ensuring the device is securely seated before starting the run.

steps.title: Select P1000 pipette mount
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 software, specify which mount (left or right) holds the P1000 Single‑Channel Pipette (GEN2) that will be used for all liquid handling steps.

steps.title: Specify number of samples (multiples of 10)
steps.instruction: Enter the total number of samples to be processed; it must be a multiple of 10 (e.g., 10, 20, or 30).

steps.title: Transfer individual samples to pool wells
steps.instruction: For each group of ten samples, the P1000 picks up a fresh tip, aspirates 62 µL of the sample followed by a 50 µL air gap, and dispenses the volume into the designated pooling well (samples 1‑10 → well A1; samples 11‑20 → well A5; samples 21‑30 → well C1). After dispensing, discard the used tip in the waste bin before proceeding to the next sample.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate an additional 50 µL air gap.
Dispense the combined volume into the correct pooling well.
Drop the tip into the waste bin.

steps.title: Mix pooled sample and load Cepheid
steps.instruction: After all ten samples of a batch are in the pooling well, use the P1000 to mix the pooled sample (e.g., by pipetting up and down), then aspirate 300 µL of the mixed pool and dispense it into the corresponding slot of the Cepheid device on the deck.

steps.title: Repeat for each 10‑sample batch
steps.instruction: Repeat the transfer (step 4) and mix‑transfer (step 5) procedures for each subsequent 10‑sample batch until the total number of samples (up to 30) has been processed.
